threat_event: Attacker in dispatch changes routes or consignees for hazmat loads to divert them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TMS dispatch changes are not alerted; security plan has no cyber measures
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (consignee and route changes not alerted); EV-082 (no cyber measures in the plan)
treatment_plan: Alert on consignee and route changes for security plan loads; two-person approval

threat_event: Telematics vendor compromise disables tracking and panic alerts
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (single telematics vendor; SOC 2 report on file)
treatment_plan: Check calls when tracking is lost; vendor incident notice terms
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: Shared ELD support accounts hide who edited hours of service records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared ELD support accounts at 6 terminals
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (shared ELD support accounts at 6 terminals)
treatment_plan: Unique accounts for all ELD support personnel
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: Ransomware stops electronic shipping papers and dispatch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipping papers depend on ERP and the TMS
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (shipping papers from ERP); EV-024 (hourly TMS backups)
existing_controls: Paper papers from shippers; hourly TMS backups
treatment_plan: Terminal print kits with pre-printed papers; tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Driver qualification and drug and alcohol testing records are breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS records for about 4,600 current and former drivers
likelihood_basis: EV-085 (records for about 2,700 current and 1,900 former drivers)
treatment_plan: Vendor access review; least privilege for terminal staff
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

threat_event: Driver-facing camera AI scores lead to unfair discipline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scores feed discipline without documented human review
likelihood_basis: EV-084 (scores used in discipline with no recorded review)
regulatory_driver: State AI employment laws (Illinois HB 3773; Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01)
treatment_plan: Documented review before discipline; notice to drivers (P10)
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

threat_event: Carrier security plan misses cyber threats en route
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Risk assessment covers only physical threats
treatment_plan: Add cyber threats to dispatch, shipping papers, telematics, and ELDs
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

threat_event: Hazmat Transport relies on group controls it has not documented
owner: Hazmat Transport security and compliance lead

threat_event: Staff follow the 2023 supplement where it conflicts with group policy
owner: Hazmat Transport security and compliance lead

threat_event: A driver tablet with shipping papers and customer data is lost
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (tablets under device management with remote wipe)
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: Cargo tank sensor data is spoofed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sensor data used for status only
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (sensor data used for status only)
owner: Hazmat Transport Director of Fleet Technology

threat_event: A dispatcher diverts a load for an outside party
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (dispatchers can change consignees); EV-082 (background checks)

threat_event: Terminal staff are phished and their accounts used against dispatch
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (shared terminal front-office accounts allowed); EV-094 (risk interviews)
owner: Hazmat Transport security and compliance lead

threat_event: Maintenance records outage hides an overdue cargo tank test
likelihood_basis: EV-081 (maintenance records in SYS-T4; paper records at shops)
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR Part 180 (cargo tank tests; not assessed here)
owner: Hazmat Transport Vice President of Safety and Compliance

likelihood_basis: EV-094 (fuel card controls run by the card vendor)

threat_event: A shipper sees another shipper's load data in the tracking portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant filtering in the TMS portal
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (tenant filtering in the shipper portal)
